newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Jan 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Jan 10.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

Sir Paul Condon, the Commissioner of the Metropolitan Police, announced today that the number of murders in the capital has fallen to a 15-year low, with burglaries and robberies continuing to fall. Sir Paul attributed the decrease in murders partly to the success of the police in tackling armed robberies, contract killings and wars between rival drug gangs.
NORTHERN ROCK IN 40 MLN STG HEALTH MOVE
Northern Rock has confirmed that it is buying Kingsclear Homes,

a Middlesex-based private nursing homes group, for 40 million pounds stg. This is a surprising move for the soon-to-be converted building society, since quoted banks do not tend to own significant subsidiaries outside the financial sector.
PRESSURE STAYS ON EXPORTERS AS POUND KEEPS UP THE GAINS
Sterling continued to rise overnight, putting on another two thirds of a pfennig against the D-mark at one point, to the dismay of major British exporters.

China's Vice Premier and chief economic policymaker, Zhu Rongji, has asserted that unprofitable State enterprises must continue to undergo reforms, even if they result in bankruptcies and unemployment.
